dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, thin-lined light-colored perimeters forming distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped rings across the mid-dorsal and posterior regions; gradients show sharp transitions from dark base fur to high-intensity line-work with dark internal centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid high-intensity light pixel clusters in the anterior shoulder and neck region, transitioning to larger, more isolated solid light-intensity blobs along the mid-body and lower lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangle is formed by connecting the centroids of the two largest mid-dorsal annuli and a prominent solid light blob located ventrally between them; an obtuse-angled relationship exists between the anterior neck clusters and the primary dorsal annulus.
